# Light the Night
> You are cordially invited to an evening of worship and prayer. Come worship and pray with us on Saturday, October 31, 2026, at 7:00 PM Central Time; doors open at 6:00 PM.

- Venue: Grand Ballroom, Sixteenth Floor, Trump International Hotel & Tower Chicago, 401 N Wabash Ave, Chicago, IL 60611
- Admission: by personal invitation only; kindly register via Eventbrite (https://www.eventbrite.com/e/light-the-night-tickets-2003689005754)
- Tickets: this invitation is extended personally; each guest receives a personal, single-use admission QR code that admits one guest and is scanned once upon arrival. Kindly do not share it.
- Bring: your personal Eventbrite QR code (phone or printed)
